paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael, father of Rabbi Yudan.
He is mentioned in Gittin ch. 1, halakhah 2: "He asked: even from Akko to Akko."

Mavo HaYerushalmi, 108b, argues that he originated all the teachings introduced as “The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught,” and authored the Mekhilta of Rabbi Yishmael; the work discusses this at length. But Hyman says that the learned and pious Rabbi Meir Ish Shalom already refuted him sharply in the introduction to the Mekhilta, chapter 12, showing that his argument has no substance. See there.
